FAQ

FAQ — greater montreal delivery

How much does a delivery in Montreal cost?

The price depends on distance, volume and timing (express or scheduled). It is confirmed before pickup. For regular shipments, we offer an agreed rate.

How fast can you deliver on the island of Montreal?

With express service, a courier usually picks up within the hour and delivers within the following hours. With scheduled service, you choose the time slot, same day or next day.

Do you deliver pallets in the city?

Yes, with a liftgate and pallet jack for addresses without a loading dock.

Do you work with stores and businesses?

That is the core of our business: distributors, retailers, online stores, workshops and offices across Greater Montreal, on regular routes or on demand.
